title: SenWiCh: Sense-Annotation of Low-Resource Languages for WiC using Hybrid Methods
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating sense-annotated linguistic datasets for Word-in-Context (WiC) tasks in low-resource languages. While it mentions the word 'religion' as a sense label for specific words in the dataset (e.g., for the Kannada word 'ಮತ'), it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical reasoning, representation, or values.
